tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Full-text search across blog posts and tools. Returns title, URL, excerpt, and a markdown_url for the full document.

tools.name: fetch_markdown
tools.description: Returns the full markdown content of any page on the site. Append .md to any permalink and pass it as `url`.

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: Returns the open datasets behind the site's AI search studies, with CSV/JSON download URLs, license, and the source article.

tools.name: get_review_verdict
tools.description: Finds the site's hands-on review of a product and returns its exact rating out of 5, verdict, key facts, pros and cons, with the review URL and last-updated date. Comparison reviews return one verdict per product.

product.description: Product or tool name, e.g. "Semrush" or "Promptwatch"

tools.name: get_key_facts
tools.description: Returns an article's summary (TL;DR), its FAQ answers and the sources it cites, with the URL and last-updated date. Pass a url, or a query to find matching articles.

query.description: Topic to search for when no url is given
